# MLX-VLM

MLX-VLM is a package for inference and fine-tuning of Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Omni Models (VLMs with audio and video support) on your Mac using MLX.

## Installation

The easiest way to get started is to install the `mlx-vlm` package using pip:

```sh
pip install -U mlx-vlm
```

The [Gradio chat UI](#chat-ui-with-gradio) needs an extra dependency that is not
part of the base install:

```sh
pip install -U 'mlx-vlm[ui]'
```

Quote the package name so that shells which expand square brackets, such as
`zsh`, do not treat `[ui]` as a glob pattern.

## Usage

### Command Line Interface (CLI)

Generate output from a model using the CLI:

```sh
# Text generation
mlx_vlm.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct-4bit --max-tokens 100 --prompt "Hello, how are you?"

# Image generation
mlx_vlm.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct-4bit --max-tokens 100 --temperature 0.0 --image http://images.cocodataset.org/val2017/000000039769.jpg

# Audio generation (New)
mlx_vlm.generate --model mlx-community/gemma-3n-E2B-it-4bit --max-tokens 100 --prompt "Describe what you hear" --audio /path/to/audio.wav

# Multi-modal generation (Image + Audio)
mlx_vlm.generate --model mlx-community/gemma-3n-E2B-it-4bit --max-tokens 100 --prompt "Describe what you see and hear" --image /path/to/image.jpg --audio /path/to/audio.wav
```

#### Thinking Budget

For thinking models (e.g., Qwen3.5), you can limit the number of tokens spent in the thinking block:

```sh
mlx_vlm.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen3.5-2B-4bit \
  --thinking-budget 50 \
  --thinking-start-token "<think>" \
  --thinking-end-token "</think>" \
  --enable-thinking \
  --prompt "Solve 2+2"
```

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--enable-thinking` | Activate thinking mode in the chat template |
| `--thinking-budget` | Max tokens allowed inside the thinking block |
| `--thinking-start-token` | Token that opens a thinking block (default: `<think>`) |
| `--thinking-end-token` | Token that closes a thinking block (default: `</think>`) |

latestRelease.body:
## What's Changed
* Vendor standard models by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1702
* Fix Laguna XS NVFP4 sanitizer by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1667
* Add Mage-Flow image model by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1708
* Authenticate inference API routes by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1714
* Awq quant by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1666
* Support mixed-precision compressed-tensors checkpoints (fp8 + NVFP4) by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1711
* Fix Responses instructions for Qwen chat templates by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1716
* Return model loading failures as bad requests by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1717
* Allow image editing with FLUX.2-klein-4b by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1729
* gpt_oss: honor per-layer mixed quantization (mxfp4 experts + 8-bit affine) by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1728
* Support quantized FLUX.2 models by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1730
* Add PLaMo 2.1 VL (plamo2vl) model support by @takuyaomi in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1739
* Add llm-jp-4-vl (llmjpvl) model support by @takuyaomi in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1738
* Fix chunked MRoPE positions across Qwen VL models by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1741
* Fix multi-image SFT grid collation by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1744

## New Contributors
* @takuyaomi made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/1739

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/compare/v0.6.7...v0.6.8
